spec.funding_assumption: 0.01% per 8 hours held, charged to longs and credited to shorts, only for holds longer than 8 hours, applied at base and stressed cost. Zero cost is gross of both fees and funding.
spec.trade_definition: One trade is one portfolio round trip: the equal-weight mean of the coins with valid entry and exit bars. Trades are assigned to a window by entry time.
spec.hourly_return: open of hour h to open of hour h+1
spec.daily_return: 00:00 UTC open to next 00:00 UTC open
spec.block_selection: 24 candidate 3-hour blocks (wrap past midnight allowed), ranked by pooled TRAIN mean of the 3-hour open-to-open return
spec.sharpe: per-trade mean / std * sqrt(trades per year)
spec.pass_rule: stressed-cost mean > 0 in validate and holdout, holdout stressed t >= 2
spec.real_but_not_tradable_rule: zero-cost mean > 0 in all three windows, holdout zero-cost t >= 2, and fails the pass rule
